summary: DueByte 0.3.64 makes funding consent receipts atomic and durable in all three packages. Interrupted writes fail closed, existing receipts cannot be replaced, and uncertain delivery requires reconciliation before retry. Installation does not issue tokens, submit funding, start warmup or activate exchange. Existing chain, wallet keys, balances and signing history are retained. Home63 updates automatically; Linux Server requires coordinated manual installation. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
